paper_title: SepLLM Accelerate Large Language Models by Compressing One Segment into   One Separator
caption: : Loss Ratio FLOPs
model_annotation: This plot illustrates the relationship between TFLOPs and Loss Ratio for different configurations of SepLLM and a baseline Vanilla model. The x-axis represents TFLOPs on a logarithmic scale, ranging from 1e7 to 9e8, with tick labels at 1e7, 2e7, 5e7, 1e8, 2e8, 3e8, 4e8, 5e8, 6e8, 7e8, 8e8, and 9e8. The y-axis represents the Loss Ratio as a percentage on a linear scale, spanning from 94 to 100 with tick labels at intervals of 1. The plot features five lines representing different models: Vanilla (purple, star marker, solid line), SepLLM (n=64) (orange, dash marker, solid line), SepLLM (n=128) (blue, square marker, solid line), SepLLM (n=64, H) (green, triangle marker, solid line), and SepLLM (n=64, H/T) (red, circle marker, solid line). The Vanilla line remains steady at 100% across the x-axis. The SepLLM (n=64) line starts at approximately 98.2% at 1e7 TFLOPs and reaches 100% at 3e8 TFLOPs before slightly decreasing to around 99.8% at 9e8 TFLOPs. The SepLLM (n=128) line begins at about 96.8% at 1e7 TFLOPs, increases to 99.8% at 2e8 TFLOPs, and then fluctuates between 99.4% and 99.8% from 3e8 to 9e8 TFLOPs. The SepLLM (n=64, H) line starts at around 98% at 1e7 TFLOPs, peaks at 100% at 2e8 TFLOPs, and then decreases to approximately 99.6% at 9e8 TFLOPs. The SepLLM (n=64, H/T) line begins at about 94% at 1e7 TFLOPs, rises to 98.6% at 3e8 TFLOPs, and then gradually declines to around 98.4% at 9e8 TFLOPs.
